one_line_description: Cloud-based customer service, helpdesk ticketing, and CRM communications platform.

credential_access.notes: 14-day free trial allows self-serve API token generation; admin privileges required to enable API access in admin center.

mcp.notes: Composio provides Zendesk toolkit; community MCP server implementations exist.

buildability.rationale: End-users cannot provision integrations directly; tenant admin consent or security review is mandatory.
